verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly confirm multi-folder projects: 'a project can work with one folder or multiple folders (e.g., a frontend and a backend repo), providing your agents with all of the context required for your codebase,' and 'Group your conversations into Projects, which can span multiple folders,' with Projects defining folder/repo access boundaries. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of this specific multi-folder feature, and no detail on limits or cross-repo navigation quirks.
